name: SEAMAN transfer business-logic flaw
summary: SEAMAN's transfer() triggers a GVC buy-back sized from the pair's live reserves on every transfer, so the attacker repeatedly forced that internal swap and drained the GVC/USDT pool.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
